title_es: AWS Organizations y control de costos
body_es: AWS Organizations es el servicio de gestión centralizada multi-cuenta de AWS que permite consolidar múltiples cuentas de AWS en una jerarquía organizacional. La estructura comprende la cuenta raíz (Management Account), Unidades Organizativas (OUs) que agrupan cuentas, y las cuentas miembro. Las Service Control Policies (SCPs) son el mecanismo de control clave: definen los permisos máximos disponibles en cuentas miembro, actuando como límites infranqueables incluso para los administradores de esas cuentas. Los SCPs no otorgan permisos; solo los restringen. La Facturación Consolidada agrega el uso de todas las cuentas para beneficiarse de descuentos por volumen y compartir Reserved Instances y Savings Plans entre cuentas. AWS Control Tower automatiza el aprovisionamiento de entornos multi-cuenta bien arquitecturados (Landing Zones) con guardrails de cumplimiento predefinidos. Para optimización de costos, AWS Cost Explorer visualiza el gasto histórico y proyectado por servicio, cuenta o tag. AWS Budgets crea alertas cuando el gasto supera umbrales definidos o cuando la utilización de Reserved Instances cae por debajo de un porcentaje. Los Cost Allocation Tags permiten atribuir costos a equipos, proyectos o centros de coste. Para el SAA-C03: Organizations + SCPs para gobernanza multi-cuenta, Consolidated Billing para economías de escala, Cost Explorer y Budgets para visibilidad y control de costos, y Trusted Advisor para recomendaciones de optimización en seguridad, rendimiento y costos.
body_en: AWS Organizations provides centralized management and governance across multiple AWS accounts. The organizational hierarchy consists of the Management (root) account, Organizational Units (OUs) that group member accounts by business unit or environment, and individual member accounts. Service Control Policies (SCPs) are JSON policy documents attached to the root, OUs, or individual accounts that define the maximum available permissions — they act as guardrails, never granting permissions themselves, only restricting what identity-based policies in member accounts can do. A Deny in an SCP cannot be overridden by any IAM policy in the affected account. Consolidated Billing aggregates usage across all accounts, enabling volume discounts on services priced in tiers and allowing Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discounts to be shared automatically across the organization. AWS Control Tower automates the creation of well-architected multi-account landing zones with pre-built preventive guardrails (SCPs) and detective guardrails (Config Rules). AWS Cost Explorer provides granular visualization of past and forecasted spending by service, linked account, region, or resource tag. AWS Budgets sets cost, usage, or reservation utilization alerts with email or SNS notifications when thresholds are breached. Cost Allocation Tags — activated in the billing console — attribute spending to teams, projects, or cost centers. For SAA-C03: know SCPs vs IAM policies (SCPs cap maximums; IAM grants within that cap), Consolidated Billing benefits, and the key cost optimization tools.
example_code:
# List organizations
aws organizations list-organizations

# Create organizational unit
aws organizations create-organizational-unit \
  --parent-id r-abc123 \
  --name Production

# Attach policy
aws organizations attach-policy \
  --policy-id p-abc123 \
  --target-id r-abc123

# Get cost and usage
aws ce get-cost-and-usage \
  --time-period Start=2024-01-01,End=2024-01-31 \
  --granularity MONTHLY \
  --metrics BlendedCost
